summary: Design (TAP-HSP90 vs TAP control, 3 biol x 2 tech, 12 .baf) and MS parameters are correct, but the required cell-line identity is incomplete: cellosaurus accession left 'not available' although HEK293T = CVCL_0063, and the cell line name does not resolve.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent; producer transcript, report.md and prior reviews not read; evidence read only from scratchpad/bkk/<PXD>/ plus independent PRIDE FTP/OLS/Cellosaurus fetches

spec_compliance.evidence: cell-lines template marks characteristics[cellosaurus accession] required with guidance 'Look up accessions at cellosaurus.org'; value 'not available' despite an unambiguous cell line.

ontology_integrity.evidence: sdrf-tools check: 'HEK 293T' in characteristics[cell line] flagged as hallucinated (not in CLO/BTO/EFO); OLS labels are 'HEK293T cell' (CLO:0037372), 'HEK-293T cell' (BTO:0002181), '293T' (EFO:0001082). Other 11 terms verified (MS:1003462 maXis impact confirmed in OLS).

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE protocols: HEK293T, TAP control vs N-terminal TAP-HSP90, DTT in lysis buffer, maXis Impact, Mascot 0.1/0.5 Da. Downloaded Empty_merge_BiolReplicate2.mzid.gz: Carbamidomethyl C fixed, Oxidation M variable, trypsin, 0.1/0.5 Da. Range-fetched .baf header: 'maXis impact'.

file_mapping.evidence: All 12 RAW .baf files mapped once; mgf/mzid/mztab excluded.

design_consistency.evidence: 6 sources (2 baits x 3 biol reps), tech reps 1-2 per source, consistent with file names and 'three independent biological replicates ... each with two technical replicates'; factor value[bait] mirrors characteristics[bait].

omission_safety.evidence: Cellosaurus accession (CVCL_0063) and Cellosaurus name (HEK293T) omitted although trivially derivable; DTT as reduction reagent rests on lysis-buffer DTT (sample 'reduced by heating at 95C').

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf with the file's declared templates: exit 0, warnings only ('Most seems to be fine. There were only warnings.'); sdrf-tools check and score run; check reports 1 hallucinated term; score 98/100.

findings.message: Set to CVCL_0063 (HEK293T) instead of 'not available'.
findings.evidence: Cellosaurus API CVCL_0063 name HEK293T, sex Female, age Fetus; PRIDE title/description 'HEK293T cells'; template marks the column required.

findings.message: 'HEK 293T' does not resolve; use the Cellosaurus/CLO name (HEK293T) and add characteristics[cellosaurus name] HEK293T.
findings.evidence: sdrf-tools check hallucinated 'HEK 293T'; validate-sdrf warning not found in clo;bto;efo; OLS CLO:0037372 'HEK293T cell'.

findings.message: 'embryonic cell' is not an exact CL label (CL:0002321 is 'embryonic cell (metazoa)').
DTT is inferred from 2 mM DTT in TAP lysis buffer; the digestion step says only 'reduced by heating at 95C'. Acceptable, but note it as an inference.
'tandem affinity purification' is free text, not a child of EFO:0009090.
Cellosaurus gives age 'Fetus'; 'embryo' is customary for HEK lines but fetal stage is the more exact value.
